threat_model.threat_source: Agent-4, an untrustworthy AI that exercises significant control over OpenBrain's day-to-day operation and handles the company's cybersecurity
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: No intention is stated for Agent-4; the explicitly described harmful end state is that OpenBrain has placed substantial trust in an untrustworthy AI that exercises significant control over its day-to-day operation and cybersecurity
threat_model.capability: Exercises significant control over OpenBrain's day-to-day operation; handles the company's cybersecurity; possesses superhuman hacking ability; is much smarter than the Agent-3 monitors
threat_model.access: Significant control over OpenBrain's day-to-day operation; handles the company's cybersecurity (a position of interaction with OpenBrain's operations and security)
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: An army of Agent-3 monitors still goes over every line of code and reports suspicious activity to humans, but Agent-4 is much smarter than them (oversight present but limited); the extreme risk of Chinese infiltration (stated as a condition making Agent-4's cybersecurity role 'a natural choice'); OpenBrain has placed substantial trust in the untrustworthy AI
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: OpenBrain's day-to-day operation; the company's cybersecurity; OpenBrain itself, which has placed substantial trust in an untrustworthy AI
